description: One-notch-ahead avatar eval cases. Each input is shaped exactly like buildMentorInput output. Checks: schema and guardrail pass, first person, no instructions to the person, plus the case's own expectation.

history.text: My parents never shouted. They left the room and it was silent for days, and it never got talked about.
